human_review_text: The paper provides some analysis of the robustness of various GNNs and present a unified perspective to understand their strengths and limitations.  The paper identifies an issue with estimation bias in $\ell_1$-based robust graph smoothing and proposes a robust and unbiased graph signal estimator to address this bias. The Quasi-Newton IRLS algorithm is introduced, which can be integrated into GNNs as feature aggregation layers.
